name: Kanazawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with a white five-petalled plum blossom charged with the character 金.
history: The flag of Kanazawa bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Kanazawa municipal emblem — a white five-petalled plum blossom charged with the character 金
features.symbolism: the umebachi plum crest of the Maeda lords of Kaga
